svg.title: Irreplaceable architecture
svg.desc: Architecture in three layers. In the browser: pages (landing, week map, Today, coach, shop, progress); the resume PDF is read locally with unpdf and only its text is sent; voice messages are recorded as 16 kHz WAV and never stored; week map maths (hours, pay at stake, score) runs with no model call. Next.js 16 server on Vercel: week map (title search, shares, the map record), reps engine (write, check, verify, grade), growth (skills, 12-week plan, Review kit), coach (context, streaming, speech to text), billing (Checkout, portal, shop codes), events (points, XP, streak, leaderboard), auth (scrypt passwords, device secrets) and the AI client (strict schemas, budget reservation, failover). Services: Upstash Redis (profiles, maps, reps, budget), OpenRouter (Gemini 3.8 Flash and GPT-6 Luna), Stripe (Checkout in test mode) and the data bundles (O*NET, AEI, GPTs labels, BLS).
